description: Ex-SAVA (Serviços Aéreos do Vale Amazônico) C-46 that force-landed here in 1971 and was abandoned; a stripped but complete hulk (no engines or propellers) that has become a local landmark and photo attraction, reported in place by g1 in 2025 and a Feb 2026 survivors compilation. Municipal plans (2023) to restore it and move it to a plaza at the airport entrance have not been executed.
museum_name: Aeroporto de Itacoatiara C-46 Commando, Itacoatiara
